newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: S.Korea firms buy at least 76,000T of Chinese corn.
newsitem.headline: S.Korea firms buy at least 76,000T of Chinese corn.

text.p: South Korean feed millers have bought at least 76,000 tonnes of Chinese corn through private negotiations over the past week, traders said on Wednesday.
Chinese product was favoured because of smaller and more convenient cargo sizes and lower freight premiums despite similar quoted prices from China's U.S. competitor, they said.
"We can buy corn in cargoes of less than 20,000 tonnes from China and without any vessel premium for the minor ports like Kunsan," a trader with local grain import company said.
Traders said South Korean firms normally buy corn from the U.S. when the shipment size exceeds 50,000 tonnes.
